properties.description: Two halves, deliberately tiny. THE DOOR: the served `log-issue` skill and its `/log-issue` command take the person's sentence, find the subject from their noun (search_design; the Project when nothing matches), and call record_finding with fact_type `follow_up`, the sentence verbatim, dated — no cause, no node type, no id asked. THE BOUNDARY READ: DesignGraph::open_follow_ups (report.rs) lists every TemporalFact with fact_type `follow_up` that carries no `valid_to` and no incoming INVALIDATES, oldest first; loop_status carries them as `follow_ups` / `follow_ups_open`, names them in `next`, counts them under `not_attributable` when scoped, and capture-session's closing step reads them out to the user. Settling is the person's judgement at the boundary — a finding with a cause, a planned check, an idea, a change record (each closes the follow-up with `invalidates`), or lapsed with a `valid_to`. `follow_up` is a convention on a free-text field made real by the one thing that reads it.
properties.name: A follow-up is captured with one word and listed at every boundary until settled
